headline: Morris wins last Players Championship; Nijman tops seedings
standfirst: Tommy Morris beat Luke Humphries 8-5 for his first ranking title, while Wessel Nijman finished top of the Players Championship Order of Merit.
body: Tommy Morris won Players Championship 34 in Leicester, the last event of the 2026 series, beating Luke Humphries 8-5 in the final for his first ranking title. Morris averaged 95.76 to Humphries' 92.43.

Morris beat Rob Cross, Ricky Evans and Rob Owen before averaging 102.32 to knock out Wessel Nijman in the last 16. He then beat Jermaine Wattimena 6-3 and Cristo Reyes 7-4. Dartsnews reported that the win lifted him from 44th to 21st on the Players Championship Order of Merit.

That list decides the 64 players in the Players Championship Finals in Minehead. Nijman finished top and will be first seed, ahead of Chris Dobey, Kevin Doets, Luke Woodhouse and Wattimena. Humphries and Beau Greaves are both in the top 10.
Luke Littler, the defending champion, will not play in Minehead. He finished outside the top 100 on the Order of Merit after skipping several events, including the final double-header in Leicester.
Ricardo Pietreczko just missed out in 66th place.
